title: CDC Lyme disease reported cases by state and year, 1992-2023
unit: reported cases (sum of aggregate cells for the state)
definition: Confirmed and probable reported cases by state under each surveillance-era definition.
method: Sum of the frequency column by state, year and case status.
comparability: Reported cases are a passive-surveillance subset of true cases.
The definition changed in 2022; do not compare across that break.
how_to_use: Cross-check the state-level case count a document reports for the same year.

provenance.collection_note: Case reports submitted by state health departments; passive reporting, so counts are a subset of true cases.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: Reported cases are a passive-surveillance subset of true cases.
provenance.reliability: Counts, not estimates; subject to under-reporting and to the 2022 definition change.
